neural stem cells are a promising cell‐based therapy for cancer, and their potential use for cancer treatment has been demonstrated in preclinical studies and in early clinical trials.
neural stem cells are a very promising cell‐based delivery platform that could be used for targeted cancer therapy.

we have shown that the NSCs are tumor tropic and can be used to deliver various anticancers payloads selectively to the tumor site.

NSCs are tumor‐tropism cells that can be engineered to deliver anticancer payloads to tumor foci throughout a patient's body.
NSCs can be used to deliver anticancer therapies in a highly targeted manner to tumor sites, which can improve therapeutic efficacy and decrease toxicity.
